license.notice:
Lingonberry English meaning corrections, edition 4.0.0.

English and Korean definitions were adjudicated against licensed lexical sources and edited with AI assistance. This is not native-speaker certification. Corrections and new Korean translations adapted from Wiktionary/NIKL retain CC BY-SA 4.0 and per-entry source, history and snapshot references. Original source provenance remains preserved in the immutable earlier packages and correction ledger. Retired concepts do not transfer mastery to replacement entries. No audio or third-party quotations are imported.

Sources credited in this correction edition: Chinese Wiktionary contributors; English Wiktionary contributors; French Wiktionary contributors; Japanese Wiktionary contributors; Korean Wiktionary contributors; National Institute of Korean Language. Wiktionary definition text retains CC BY-SA 4.0; NIKL source text retains CC BY-SA 2.0 KR. Article and contributor-history URLs, source snapshot identifiers and selected senses are retained in each correction record.

Earlier source notices:

Learn Language example expansion, edition 3.0.0.

Original examples and translations by Learn Language contributors, 2026, CC BY 4.0. These are AI-assisted editorial drafts; fluent-speaker review remains pending. Sense, article and grammatical corrections to licensed dictionary entries are CC BY-SA 4.0 adaptations. Stable entry IDs and original source provenance are retained. The authoring and correction records are included in language-packages/sources/examples/. No unreviewed model output, audio or publisher quotations are added.

Earlier edition source notices follow:

Learn Language multilingual dictionaries, edition 2.0.0 (editorial preview).

Korean Learners' Dictionary (한국어기초사전), National Institute of Korean Language (국립국어원): Korean headwords, definitions, translated equivalents/definitions and Korean sentence examples. Original text licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.0 Korea. Source: https://krdict.korean.go.kr/ . Copyright policy: https://krdict.korean.go.kr/kor/kboardPolicy/copyRightTermsInfo . Licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/kr/ . Each imported entry retains its source entry and sense identifiers and direct source URL. XML export dated 19 June 2026, redistributed by spellcheck-ko/korean-dict-nikl at commit 42c0d01889f34536e9cf94fe57f62bd2055b1bde.

Adaptations by Learn Language contributors: reorganising bilingual equivalents into study-language headwords, selecting senses, adding editorial levels and topic tags, normalising forms and linking lexical facts. Adaptations are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0, using the later same-elements licence option in section 4(2) of the original Korean licence. Unmodified source text retains its original licence. Native-speaker review is pending; no official exam membership or dictionary-provider endorsement is claimed.

English Wiktionary contributors: grammatical facts and contributor-authored usage examples extracted via Kaikki/Wiktextract. Text licence CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Each reused item retains the source article URL and contributor-history URL. Quotation-type examples, attributed quotations, images and audio are excluded. Source translations present in the extract are identified as source English translations, not newly reviewed translations. https://kaikki.org/dictionary/rawdata.html

National Institute of Korean Language, 2017 International Standard Curriculum for the Korean Language (vocabulary spreadsheet revised 2020): headword grade evidence, under Korea Open Government Licence Type 1 (attribution). https://www.korean.go.kr/front/reportData/reportDataView.do?mn_id=207&report_seq=932 . Curriculum grades are not exhaustive TOPIK exam word lists; homograph matches are headword-level evidence only.

The original 1.0.0 starter definitions and bilingual examples remain CC BY 4.0, Learn Language contributors, 2026: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . They are preserved with their stable identifiers. App code remains MIT.

Keep source credits, licence links, contributor-history links and modification notices when redistributing. ShareAlike applies to covered adapted content; the app's independently written code has its own licence. Data JSON is provided separately without DRM through the repository download links. Do not apply extra contractual or technical restrictions to the licensed data. No external speech recordings are bundled; speech uses device voices. Store-distribution compliance and language review remain release checks, not completed certifications.

Complete bilingual example coverage has not been achieved. Untranslated native source examples are labelled separately and are excluded from sentence quizzes. No generic repeated topic sentence is counted as a completed usage example.

Wordfreq 3.1.1, Robyn Speer and contributors: frequency estimates used for editorial ordering, not exam membership. Code is Apache-2.0; distributed frequency data is CC BY-SA 4.0. See https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq for the source-data acknowledgements and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . Frequency is a historic usage estimate and does not establish the difficulty of a specific sense.

Wordfreq source acknowledgements: Google Books Ngrams and Syntactic Ngrams; University of Leeds Centre for Translation Studies Internet Corpus; Wikipedia contributors; ParaCrawl; OPUS/OpenSubtitles 2018 and the OpenSubtitles project; SUBTLEX-US, UK, CH, DE and NL authors including Brysbaert, New, Buchmeier, Conrad, Jacobs, Bölte, Böhl, Cai, Keuleers, van Heuven, Mandera and colleagues. SUBTLEX remains freely available at https://crr.ugent.be/programs-data/subtitle-frequencies . Full upstream citations: https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq#citations-to-work-that-wordfreq-is-built-on . Language exercises: Original Lingonberry exercises and bilingual explanations, 2026. AI-assisted authoring and editorial checks; not native-speaker certification. Reference links document lexical and historical facts only. No publisher exercises, example sentences, definitions, quotations or audio are reproduced. Existing dictionary entries retain their separate licences. This is a focused starter collection, not complete English grammar or exam coverage. Preclude and occlude now have linked dictionary entries; illicit is a contrast item anchored to elicit, not a claim of dictionary coverage. Levels come from linked core entries and are editorial study tiers, not official IELTS vocabulary lists. Licence: MIT. notice.en: The four IELTS-labelled groups are editorial study bands, not exam word lists or score predictions. They progress from basic everyday meanings through general vocabulary to SAT-style academic and GRE-level vocabulary.
notice.ko: IELTS 이름이 붙은 네 단계는 편집 기준의 학습 구간으로, 공식 시험 단어 목록이나 점수 예측이 아닙니다. 기초 일상 어휘, 일반 어휘, SAT형 학술 어휘, GRE 수준 어휘 순으로 구성됩니다.

contentReview.levelBasis: Every stored sense receives an editorial difficulty review. SAT-style academic vocabulary is followed by 1000+ distinct GRE-level words; no official exam membership or score equivalence.

retiredEntries.reason: The indefinite collection gloss is wrong; source supports a noun for an indicated thing.
Replace an indefinite collection gloss with the attested demonstrative noun sense.
The imported Korean pronoun-and-particle rule is not an English concept; use attested masculine subject pronoun.
The imported people-total sense is pronoun everyone and duplicates existing all/pronoun; retire this misclassified duplicate without replacing its ID.
One does not alone mean expert; replace with attested characteristic-bearing individual sense.
Upper surface is not noun up; use the supported upward-direction concept with a new ID.
Same question-time concept as existing when/adverb with an example; preserve survivor ID and retire duplicate.
Exclusive-only sense is already represented by only/adverb; the imported Korean grammatical construction creates a misclassified duplicate.
Exact many/determiner large-number duplicate; retain existing example-bearing entry.
Final-order sense belongs to last/adjective already present; unrelated noun footwear and freight senses must not be substituted to fill this row.
The alleged endearing object sense lacks support; replace it with the attested small-amount noun, not a speculative renamed headword.
Imported noun each individual is wrong; the closest supported individual-exclusive sense is adjective own, with no existing adjective duplicate.
Additionally in the future is not an English sense; replace it with the supported any-time sense.
The pleading source maps to the adverb entry already present; preserve a distinct attested interjection sense under a new concept ID.
At spare moments is not supported as adverb free; use the attested no-payment adverb with a new concept ID.
Proposing a motion and seconding it are different concepts; the corrected support sense requires a new ID.
Indefinite-anything concept already exists as pronoun; retire the misclassified noun duplicate.
The imported Korean connective rule is unrelated; replace it with attested meaning/signification verb.
The imported domestic-related abstraction is not noun local; replace with attested local-resident concept.
The one-rather-than-many concept is already single/adjective; noun senses are specific items and do not justify this abstract duplicate.
Near future is not a noun coming sense; replace with attested arrival concept.
The small-plural-quantity sense is already several/determiner; imported noun many things duplicates it.
Long elapsed time is misaligned; use the closely related late-stage concept.
Shortened-word concept belongs to the existing abbreviation entry; noun short does not support this imported meaning.

Final as a noun does not denote the general end of a span of time. Preserve the valid English headword and replace the imported temporal-end concept with the attested university-examination sense under a new ID.
The opportunity-seizing Korean exclamation is not English fine; use attested reluctant-acceptance sense.
Delegating one’s task and coercing someone are different concepts; use attested coercion sense with a new ID.
Even so is not adverb whatever; use the closest supported dismissive discourse response as a new concept.
A salute command and the attention posture are different actions; repair the English military command under a new concept ID.
The Korean school grade 양 is not an English lexical noun poor. Inspected English noun senses concern poor people or a card-game rank; replacing with these unrelated senses would corrupt the concept.
Generic relationship-building is too vague; use supported contractual-engagement sense as a new concept.

Generic extra-large size does not match an English noun super. Inspected noun senses are specific clippings such as supertanker, not generic size; do not substitute an unrelated clipping merely to fill this row.
Unknown-whereabouts state is already missing/adjective; imported noun disappearance duplicates that concept and is unsupported as the statistical missing-value noun.
The Korean grammatical-expression gloss is not an English sense; replace with attested visual-perception noun.
The old gloss describes feeling moved; moving means causing emotion. This causal-role reversal requires a new concept ID.
The identical soft-tissue definition already exists under flesh; weight is the wrong headword, so retire the duplicate mapping.
The imported black crude-oil concept is wrong for gas; replace with the closely related attested liquid-fuel sense and mark region.
Content is a mistaken spelling for contend in this competition definition; the same sense already exists under contend. Do not retain content as an answer alias.
The yin-yang philosophical category 양 is not established by this English noun positive; the attested affirmed-thing sense is unrelated and should not be substituted simply to fill the row.
The original describes the person feeling pleased; welcome describes the gladly received person or thing, requiring a new concept for the role change.
Importance/large-effect concept already exists in the authored significant/adjective entry; retire the misclassified noun duplicate.
The imported written/authored meta-gloss does not define the person; use the supported creator concept under a new ID.
A workplace and a vacant job are different concepts; use the attested vacancy sense with a new ID.
Generic Korean playing-card terminology is wrong; preserve a nearby attested card-game concept with its historical label and a new ID.
The hidden-state concept is already secret/adjective; imported verb is a misclassified duplicate.
Personal satisfaction after an act and actual effectiveness are different concepts; use supported capacity to produce the required result under a new ID.
A Korean scooping-manner expression is not the English completeness modifier; use the attested sense with a new ID.
The imported Korean emphatic construction is not an English noun meaning; replace with attested lexical-signification sense.
The old all-night period is a different time concept from evening; use attested afternoon-to-night period with a new ID.
The plant-seed concept already exists under seed; species is a wrong mapping of Korean 종.
People passing to and fro is the traffic movement noun already represented; verb traffic in this source concerns trading, not the imported movement action.
Abandoning conscience for profit is not the same concept as making a false statement; use the attested deception verb under a new ID.
The state of marriage and the wedding ceremony are distinct concepts; correct to the attested ceremony sense under a new ID.
Mature-looking composure is not the same as recognised authority; replace with the nearest supported social-credibility sense.
Centre-of-attention and competition winner are different concepts; use the attested winning person or thing with a new ID.
The yin philosophical category 음 is not established as English noun negative; do not replace it with an unrelated refusal or photographic sense.
Harbouring an emotion is not deciding; use supported deliberative-choice concept under a new ID.
Raw strength of a power is not proud; use the closest attested majestic-bearing sense under a new ID.
Restricting a range is not bridging it; use the supported connecting/across-gap concept under a new ID.
Being subject to power is not leadership; use the supported capacity-to-lead concept under a new ID.
The same undomesticated-state concept exists under wild/noun; tough is an incorrect headword for it.
Open and undisguised attitude belongs to existing frank/adjective; imported abstract noun is a misclassified duplicate, not the postage or sausage noun.
The imported emphasis-marker definition is not the English noun; use the supported referring relation as a new concept.
A Korean emphatic marker is not a mention; use the supported brief-reference noun under a new ID.

Quick movement as an act is not this noun; replace with the related attested express-transport concept.
Strong radiant energy is not a flow; use supported physical or figurative movement sense under a new ID.
The imported definition names a Korean vowel rather than an English study concept. The English noun ya in this source names a Cyrillic letter, so it cannot validate or replace the Korean vowel entry.
The Korean expectation-contrast construction is not considering; use its attested consideration noun with a new ID.
Business-operating activity is not noun corporate; the closest supported managerial noun is the senior leadership, requiring a new concept ID.
Originally is temporal origin; basically is fundamental manner. Use the attested basic-respects concept under a new ID.
Earlier and later time is not textual context; replace with the closest surrounding-text concept under a new ID.
Receiving votes and casting votes reverse the participant role; use the correct voting concept with a new ID.
An act of opposing change is not the person noun conservative; repair to the supported person concept under a new ID.
Equal democratic participation is not the same as a non-monarchical republic; use the supported state-form concept under a new ID.
The original describes something frightening rather than someone frightened; repair the participant role with a new concept ID.
Age or lack of originality is not typicality; use the supported normal/expected concept under a new ID.
An unspecified obstruction to bodily function is not a load; use the closest supported physical-burden concept under a new ID.
Height and depth are different measurement concepts; correct to the supported below-surface distance under a new ID.
The source Korean usage denotes an individual panellist, while English panel is the group; use the group concept under a new ID.
Generic computer output is broader than a physical print; use the supported printed-image concept under a new ID.
Desire alone is not blindness; use the nearest attested figurative failure-to-perceive sense under a new ID.

The original describes buttocks, a different body region; use the attested hip region with a new concept ID.
Feeling displeased is not being ridiculous; replace with supported absurdity sense under a new ID.
The Korean sentence-ending deference level is not an English noun formal. Inspected gown/event/parameter senses are unrelated and must not be substituted simply to fill this row.
The imported Korean vowel name is not the attested English Cyrillic-letter name yo; remove unsuitable language-metadata entry without substituting another alphabet’s letter.
Importance or value is not commitment; use the closest supported dedication concept under a new ID.
The original defines an interval between notes, not a note’s pitch; use the supported frequency-height concept under a new ID.
Being wired is a state, while wire is the conductor; use the supported object concept under a new ID.

The appearance-quality concept already exists as ugly/adjective; imported verb is a misclassified duplicate.
The far-away state is already represented by remote/adjective; noun remote instead denotes a controller or specialised broadcast/source-control object.

Sticky condensate is not refuse unless discarded; replace the material-specific mistranslation with the attested waste concept.
The original is romanised Korean Yut Nori terminology, not the attested English moment abbreviation mo; do not substitute unrelated abbreviation senses.
The Korean consonant ㅃ name is not an English noun pp. Attested percentage-point/past-participle initialisms do not validate or replace that alphabet entry.
Mere chronological succession is not a legacy; use the supported inherited-from-the-past concept under a new ID.
General detailed investigation is not an opinion poll; use the supported people-survey concept under a new ID.
A federation is not the defining concept of commonwealth; replace the unsupported federal-union concept with the attested polity sense.
Excessive violence is not radicalism; use the supported fundamental-change concept under a new ID.
Confident backtalk is not necessarily a complaint; use the supported dissatisfaction concept under a new ID.

Intelligence and strong will are not the same trait as reliability; use the supported trustworthiness concept under a new ID.
A rent-free guest need not be a dependant; use the supported support-dependency concept under a new ID.
The original describes feeling surprised; surprising is the stimulus role and requires a new concept ID.

American spelling traveling duplicates the existing British travelling journey concept. Merge into that entry and preserve traveling as a validated alternative spelling there; investigative visiting is not a separate English sense here.
The Korean vowel ㅖ name is not the English noun ye for a Cyrillic letter; remove language-metadata mistranslation without substituting a different alphabet’s letter.
The imported Chinese palace-name concept is not the English quarters sense; replace it with supported living accommodation.
The imported pleased experiencer state differs from pleasant, which describes what gives pleasure.
Touching describes an emotionally affecting thing, not the experiencer’s state of being moved.
The original equidistance-to-point-and-line definition describes a parabola, not an arc; replace with the supported curve segment concept.
Caring concerns kindness and empathy, not merely earnest effort or sincerity.
The source does not support the imported change-over-time sense; use the attested passage sense with a new concept ID.

The imported act of vaguely recalling a memory is not supported; use the closest attested history-following sense.
General thorough understanding is not identification; use the attested identity-establishing concept with a new ID.

The imported Korean vowel-name ㅘ is not an English lexical concept. Attested English wa senses refer to a canoe, a Thai measure or Japanese social harmony, none of which preserves this entry; retire rather than fabricate a rename.

The original law-making act belongs to legislation, not legislature. Preserve the valid English headword and replace the imported act concept with the supported legislative-body sense under a new ID. Korean uses 입법 기관 to avoid confusing the legislature with the executive branch.
The imported causative make-someone-experience concept is not react; replace with the supported response sense.
General contacting and discussing arrangements is not casting; use the supported performer-selection concept.
The imported meaning concerns untidy clothing or dirty behaviour; replace it with the attested moral-corruption sense using a new sense ID.
The original act-of-combining noun is unsupported; use the attested combine-harvester noun as a new sense.
The imported mild-illness concept does not match mere; adopt the attested only/no-more-than sense under a new ID.

The noun resume is not the act of resuming; select the attested summary sense, creating a new sense ID.
The original dishonoured-payment concept differs from legally recognised insolvency; replace it with the supported bankruptcy sense under a new ID.
The original cosmic creation principle is not this English noun; adopt the attested pleasing-combination sense under a new ID.
The source describes an expansive physical view; the attested adverb means visibly or without concealment, requiring a new sense ID.
Original urging/requesting action is not the urge noun; use the attested desire sense under a new ID.
The original identifies a path beside a cliff rather than the cliff itself; replace the source concept with the attested steep-rock-face sense.
The original tilted physical-position concept is misspelt as titled. Preserve the valid titled headword with its attested title-bearing sense under a new ID; do not add tilted as an alias.
Preparatory attitude does not match setup noun; use the attested arrangement sense under a new ID.
Original all-together companionship concept differs from altogether as completely; replace with an attested sense under a new ID.
Korean highest-school-grade 수 is not an English grading-specific meaning. Use the general excellence quality under a new sense ID.
Busy movement does not mean freely; adopt the attested unrestricted-manner sense under a new ID.
The original abstract degree gloss does not define miserable; replace with the attested state-of-misery sense under a new ID.
Original thrust/force concept differs physically from momentum. Use the supported mass-times-velocity concept under a new ID.
The source defines cellulose rather than fibre; use the attested strand sense under a new ID. No existing fibre noun duplicate was found; preserve valid US fiber as an alias.
Original half-hearted/insincere behaviour is not the adverb halfway. The attested partial-degree sense is the closest supported concept; create a new ID.
Use the regular action noun of the attested lift removal-of-restriction sense. The original physical dismantling concept differs and needs a new sense ID.
The original abstract single-force state is unsupported; select the attested domain/sphere sense as a new concept.
The original describes the state of ownership; the attested physical possession noun is the closest supported sense and receives a new ID.
The imported result-to-effort ratio is efficiency, a different concept. Replace with the attested effectiveness/result-achievement sense under a new ID.
Original letting-go-without-regret concept is unrelated; adopt the attested candid-speaking sense under a new ID.
The original describes an auditor rather than an audit. Replace with the attested examination concept under a new ID.
The imported Korean satnav-device meaning differs from English navigation as route-planning practice or technology; use a new sense ID.
Physical dizziness is not uncertainty; replace with the attested doubt/lack-of-certainty concept under a new ID.
The source means concealing one’s intentions, not acting deliberately. Replace with the attested intentional sense using a new ID.
Korean shamanic 굿 was imported under gut. Replace with the attested digestive-tract sense under a new ID.
The imported modern luxury-apartment loanword differs from English mansion as a large luxurious house; use a new sense ID.
The closest supported sense is signing to consent, rather than an arbitrary unilateral contract offer. Create a new sense ID.
The source firewood purpose is distinct from construction timber. Replace with the supported construction-wood sense under a new ID.

Secretly fleeing one’s country is not the legal protection called asylum; replace with the attested protection sense under a new ID.
The original unrelated concept is irrelevant, not inappropriate. Use the attested unsuitable concept under a new sense ID.
A stage or round of an affair does not match outbreak; use the supported sudden-appearance sense under a new ID.
A circulating story alone is a rumour, not necessarily speculation. Use the attested conjecture sense under a new ID.

Being captivated describes enjoyment, not inquisitiveness. Use the attested desire-to-learn sense under a new ID.
The Korean ginseng-package counter 포 is unsupported here. Preserve the real English po headword using its attested dated British chamber-pot sense under a new ID.
The Korean recruitment-act meaning differs from the English recruiter-person noun; create a new sense ID.
The original spreading malignant disease describes cancer, not all tumours. Use the supported abnormal-growth sense under a new ID and preferred British tumour; no existing tumour duplicate found.
The original spice-powder concept differs from the attested prepared-dish sense of curry; use a new ID.
Full, solid content does not define the adverb; adopt the attested large-degree sense under a new ID.
Original tapping sound likely confuses tab with tap. Use the valid attested keyboard-action tab sense under a new ID; never add tap as an alias.
The original indicator needle is a different part from the dial face. Use the attested marked-scale sense with a new ID.
The Korean vowel ㅠ mapping is unsupported; the English name yu is attested for the Cyrillic letter. Create a new letter-name sense ID.
The imported Korean fashion-stylist title differs from the English general coordination role; use a new ID.
A physical mark left on a body is not aftermath. Use the attested consequences-following-an-event sense under a new ID.
The original lending institution is not a reservoir definition; adopt the attested reserve/source sense under a new ID.
The original fighting-opponent concept is unsupported; use the attested vulgar insult sense with an explicit label under a new ID.
Original recruitment process is not the recruit person; use the attested newly enlisted person under a new ID.
The anatomical space between fingers is not clutch; use the attested grip sense under a new ID.
Use the regular action noun of the attested commit wrongdoing sense. The imported impudence meaning is different and receives a new ID.
Creditworthiness/payment-on-credit is not credibility. Use the attested believability concept under a new ID.
The source courtroom/place differs from the judicial body called a tribunal; use a new sense ID.
The imported teasing suffix for someone frequently doing something is unrelated to bully; create a new sense ID.
The abstract extreme-degree source is unrelated to the ordinary pouring action; use the attested action noun under a new ID.
Having a special meaning is not constituting something; replace with the attested form/make-up sense under a new ID.
The source describes crude oil, not the refined motor fuel gasoline. Create a new petrol sense ID and explicitly label the North American synonym.
The original temporary-assumption action is not proposition. Use the attested truth-valued statement sense under a new ID.
Moving limbs alone does not define splash; adopt the attested liquid-scattering action under a new ID.
The original institution (college) differs from the student denoted by undergraduate; create a new sense ID.
Original boxed area is not a bracket mark; use the attested British punctuation sense under a new ID.
The source runged ladder is a different boarding structure from a continuous ramp. Create a new inclined-surface sense ID.
Concealing a purpose is not doing something intentionally. Create a new sense for the attested on-purpose meaning.
